source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Logic in Computer Science (PDF 26, printed 22).

blocks.text: Computer science mein logic ka matlab hai qaidon (rules) ke mutabiq sahi faisle karna. Logic computers ko sach (true) aur jhoot (false) wali conditions (shartein) samajhne mein madad deti hai. Is se system maloomat ko sahi tarah process karta hai. Logical statements programs aur algorithms mein istemal hote hain. Yeh statements program ka flow (kaun sa hissa kab chale) control karte hain. Computer ke bohat se kaamon ki bunyad logic hai. Is se computer ek tarteeb (structured way) se sochta hai.

blocks.prompt: Computer science mein logic kya hai? Ek if-then qaida batayein jo koi program istemal kar sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: Qaidon ke mutabiq sach ya jhoot dekh kar sahi faisle karna, jo program ka flow control karte hain. Misal: agar password sahi hai to account kholo, warna error dikhao.

items: Computer science mein logic: qaidon se sahi faisle karna.
Programs mein logical statements (jaise if) flow control karte hain.
